issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int, but the solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return a StudentCount object (and adds a StudentCount class). The template does not provide StudentCount nor specify a return type. This mismatch between the specified return type (int) and the solution implementation (StudentCount) will confuse students about the expected return type and what to implement, and may cause tests or examples to diverge from the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to have getTotalNumberOfStudents() return an int (and update dependent methods to use an int) so it matches the UML and remove or adjust StudentCount; or (B) update the problem statement UML and template to specify getTotalNumberOfStudents(): StudentCount, provide the StudentCount class in the template, and document its API. Choose one consistent approach and apply it to problem_statement.md, the template Lecture.java, and the solution.
